claims.text: The Air Force contract with the University of Colorado was announced in October 1966 with initial funding of $313,000, eventually exceeding $500,000; Edward Condon directed and Robert J. Low coordinated.

edges.label: The Low memo shows the conclusion was framed before the study began
edges.note: Low's 9 August 1966 memorandum proposed a study 'conducted almost entirely by non-believers' with 'almost zero expectation of finding a saucer'. James E. McDonald found it in the project files in July 1967.

edges.label: The Condon Committee was hosted by the University of Colorado at Boulder
edges.note: The Air Force contract was announced in October 1966 at $313,000, eventually exceeding $500,000, with Condon as director and Robert Low as coordinator.

edges.label: The Condon report was the stated basis for terminating Blue Book
edges.note: The Air Force terminated Project Blue Book on 17 December 1969 in response to the Condon findings, having received the report in November 1968.
